title: ALL parallel lines to null.

do_not_reinvent.parallel: /data/true-parallels.json  true parallels already sat. not perpendicular. this is those lines, sent.
do_not_reinvent.quads: /data/parallelograms-next.json  closed parallels. they go too. do not mint a new 4-sider.
do_not_reinvent.lines: /data/localize-lines.json  lines already asked to localize. to-null is the where they localize.
do_not_reinvent.null: /data/decompose-null-knd.json + /data/grey-null-sandwich.json  decompose ALL in null. the filling. [Ø]D.
do_not_reinvent.pole: /data/one-pole-dissolve-antipole.json  all axes to one pole. parallel lines are that class. one destination.

is.to: null. the filling. the cup. not a 2nd vanishing point.

not.meet_in_space: they do not mint a new meet. they go to null. parallels stay parallel until null.

law: all parallel lines to null. one destination. if they meet halfway we stacked a pole. if they never go we left them as dump.
pull: send the parallels to null. keep them parallel until they arrive. no extra vanishing point.
